common.disclaimer: Certidrill is an independent website. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Microsoft. Microsoft and Azure are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. All questions are original and written from public documentation; none comes from a real exam.

home.title: Practice exams that feel like the real thing
home.subtitle: Timed mock exams with locked sections, case studies, a review screen and a score out of 1000 — then a detailed, explained correction.
home.closed: Registrations are currently closed: accounts are created by the administrator.

features.realistic: Realistic sessions: 100 minutes, 45 to 58 questions, every question format of the real exam.
features.variety: Several distinct mock exams, without repeating questions while the bank allows it.
features.report: Overall score, score per domain and an explained correction linked to Microsoft Learn.
features.progress: Progress tracking to know when you are ready.

login.forgot: Forgot your password? Use the magic link.
